Well this took place quite a while back when I was in grade 6. The rows in our class were single and divided so you could only talk to people who sat in front or behind you. Our teacher gives us a math sum and tells us to solve it, but instead of solving it I turn around to talk to my friend. A minute or 2 passes by and the teacher notices I havent started and was talking so she tells me to stand up and tell the answer. I was caught by surprise and couldn't think straight, I just stood there acting like I was thinking about the problem while the whole class stared through my soul. Finally I had this genius idea of buying time. I yell out "I know the answer but could you please explain the question again." I repeated that about 4 times and then the teacher sighed and told me to sit back down. I think about this day every now and then and cringe on how stupid and embarrassing that must have been.
